pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF YOU WANT TO PUT IT ANOTHER WAY, YOU’RE EASY TO READ.

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: HE DIDN'T REALIZE THAT...?

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: DON'T WORRY ABOUT IT! THAT JUST MEANS THAT WE KNOW WE CAN RELY ON YOU!

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: WHEN PEOPLE HAVE PROBLEMS, IT’S EASY FOR THEM TO CONFIDE IN YOU!

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: YOU CAN BE IN CHARGE OF BEING STUPIDLY HONEST! JUST LEAVE THE REST TO ME! WE'LL BALANCE EACH OTHER OUT!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: RIGHT... "STUPID," AGAIN...

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: OH, BUT DON'T TAKE THIS THE WRONG WAY. WE AREN'T SAYING THAT THE OTHER FIRST YEARS AREN'T TRUST-WORTHY.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: WE CONSIDERED MAKING MIKAGE THE VICE-PRESIDENT FOR A LONG TIME.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: SHE’S VERY TALENTED AND SHE’S HONEST TOO, BUT... HOW DO I PUT IT...?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: EVEN THOUGH SHE'S DEFINITELY HONEST, IT SEEMS LIKE SHE'S ALWAYS HOLDING SOMETHING BACK. IT'S ALMOST LIKE SHE WON'T LET PEOPLE TAKE THAT LAST STEP AND TRULY CONNECT WITH HER.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YOU THINK SO?

pages.speaker: character8
pages.text: ARE YOU SURE?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IT’S WOMEN’S INTUITION.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: YOU REALLY CAN'T COUNT ON THAT.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: BUT STILL, I REALLY THINK MIKAGE IS WAY BETTER SUITED FOR THIS THAN I AM...

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: HACHIKEN, HAVE SOME CONFIDENCE!

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: EVER SINCE YOU MADE THAT PIZZA AND THEN ALL THAT BACON, SOME PEOPLE STARTED CALLING YOU "THE GUY WHO WON'T REFUSE YOU."

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ME!?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: WHAT? REALLY? THAT MAKES YOU SOUND PRETTY COOL!

pages.speaker: character8
pages.text: SO, YOU’RE LIKE A GUY WHO NEVER TURNS DOWN PEOPLE WHO COME ASKING FOR HELP?

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: THAT’S HOW MUCH PEOPLE PUT THEIR TRUST IN YOU!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: C’MON, BE THE NEW VICE-PRESIDENT!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ALL RIGHT •

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: GOOD LUCK, "GLY WHO CAN'T REFUSE YOU!"

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHAT!? ONE OF YOUR WORDS IS WRONG! THAT MAKES ME SOUND LIKE ILET PEOPLE WALK ALL OVER ME!!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: SEE YOU LATER, WE'LL COME VISIT YOU GUYS EVERY ONCE IN A WHILE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: OKAY! GOOD LUCK JOB HUNTING!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: LOOKS LIKE IT’S GOING TO RAIN.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I’D BETTER HURRY BACK TO THE DORMS
